sql:
CREATE VIEW orders_view AS
SELECT *,
(SELECT CASE
   WHEN ord.approver_ref=1 THEN '---' ELSE 'Approved'
 END) AS "Approved",
(SELECT CASE
 WHEN ord.ordercanceled
 THEN 'Canceled'
 ELSE
  (SELECT CASE
		WHEN ord.po_ref=1
		THEN
		 (SELECT CASE
				WHEN ord.approver_ref=1
				THEN '---'
				ELSE 'Approved'
			END)
		ELSE 'PO'
	END)
END) AS "Status",
(CASE
 WHEN ord.ordercanceled
 THEN 'Canceled'
 ELSE
  (CASE
		WHEN ord.po_ref=1
		THEN
		 (CASE
				WHEN ord.approver_ref=1
				THEN '---'
				ELSE 'Approved'
			END)
		ELSE 'PO'
	END)
END) AS "Status_OK"
FROM orderstest ord
shape: CREATE VIEW orders_view AS SELECT *, (SELECT CASE WHEN ord.approver_ref = 1 THEN '---' ELSE 'Approved' END) AS "Approved", (SELECT CASE WHEN ord.ordercanceled THEN 'Canceled' ELSE (SELECT CASE WHEN ord.po_ref = 1 THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN ord.approver_ref = 1 THEN '---' ELSE 'Approved' END) ELSE 'PO' END) END) AS "Status", (CASE WHEN ord.ordercanceled THEN 'Canceled' ELSE (CASE WHEN ord.po_ref = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN ord.approver_ref = 1 THEN '---' ELSE 'Approved' END) ELSE 'PO' END) END) AS "Status_OK" FROM orderstest AS ord;
